decisions.summary: route search keeps off its own house only (as main); first step from the door may span two cells and is judged by house_clear/fixtures_clear/parts_clear; last leg refused by standing_ground; heuristic once a cell; door's grid kept, map grid withdrawn (R4); own-parts blocking withdrawn on R12
decisions.why: The change WITHDRAWS a lever, and the withdrawal is required, not chosen: FR-005 forbids a seed failing that the base passed, and R12 records seed 13 at 20 households refused (WebRefused) with own parts on and rolled with them off. FR-004's 'a round that does not pay is withdrawn' independently holds: at 20 households the end bookend read +7.7% with seeds 4 and 39 +34.9%/+22.0%. Nothing the GM asked for is narrowed: every path offered still passes the placer's full rules (FR-003) and no rule changed. Code matches the plan (route.py: mine = [(own, hgap)] only; first_ok and goal_of keep their tests). R13's figures re-summed from the logs: 15 hh 20.31 -> 19.18 s, 40 hh 46.47 -> 36.10 s, 240/240 and 400/400 seated, every seed on margin 1; 20 hh homesteads 12.25 -> 11.01 s, web 9.04 -> 8.32 s; seeds 4/8/12 at 40 as stated. SC-001 (>=10% at 40) holds at -22%. Observation, not a narrowing: 'kept on R13's numbers' is a cumulative timing of all rounds against main, not of D3's changed form alone, the same cumulative reading round 2 accepted for D4.

decisions.summary: (research R12, relied on by D3) the seating's tree_admits admits corridors that break the lane law once the web squares/joins them; not fixed in this feature, raised with the GM
decisions.why: Not a narrowing of the GM's request: the request is the homesteads stage's speed; the defect is a pre-existing correctness gap in feature 287's seating/web contract, and with D3 as changed it does not reach a map (seed 13 rolls on both, R13). Fixing it would not by itself restore the withdrawn lever, since R12 attributes seeds 4 and 39's web slowdown to a separate mechanism (island lanes that _join_orphan_ways cannot join), and R13 records that the web paid back the 15-household gain. Whether deferring it satisfies constitution XIV is a matter for the GM (raised), not request fidelity. US2's stopping rule still binds: before the iteration stops, the record must name the route search's remaining cost and either the stage doing what an efficient process would, or a measured reason it cannot.
